description: Use when the user (RP owner) wants to register a new OAuth callback URL — for example after deploying to a new domain (easybracket.org), adding an iOS scheme, or staging environment. Idempotent: no-op if the URI is already registered. Server-side validators run (URI shape, sandbox host whitelist, app_link host match) and the change is recorded in developer_audit_logs. Requires PAK scope apps:manage. Confirm with the user before calling — adding the wrong URI widens the attack surface for token interception. Pair with logi_show_app afterward to verify.
name: logi_add_redirect_uri
